title: Listening Drill — Garden show update
description: Public announcement. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Garden show update
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: A quick update about the garden show. Some of you have printed the original programme, so please take a moment to change your notes. The most important change concerns parking arrangements.

ORGANISER: For now, go to the farm gate. If that route is closed when you arrive, use the village road instead. It takes a few minutes longer, so allow enough time.

ORGANISER: Questions should go to James rather than the general enquiries desk. Before you leave, keep your ticket for re-entry. We will post a further update only if another part of the plan changes.
